recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. The current build-scope source satisfies FHIR-15615; any future broader canonical URL/version policy work should be handled under later Jira issues rather than duplicating prose here.
issue_request: FHIR-15615 asked to improve scattered descriptions of logical, literal, business, and canonical identifiers by giving canonical URLs more prominence in Resource Identity, mentioning the canonical data type and use, and pointing readers to references.html Canonical URLs.
initial_application: The issue was applied in git commit 7ee661f6b4 (svn 14500), which explicitly mentioned GF#15615 with GF#17105 and GF#14191. That commit removed the old one-sentence url mention, added Resource Identity structure, added a Canonical URLs subsection to source/resource/resource-notes.xml, and updated source/references.html canonical guidance.
additional_context: Resource is active in source/fhir.ini and part of the normative infrastructure package. Later canonical-reference changes preserved the Resource Identity canonical section and the cross-links. FHIR-17105 and FHIR-14191 share the same application commit and explain adjacent wording, but were not separately decided in this seed audit.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because current source/resource/resource-notes.xml already explains canonical URLs as a special kind of business identifier, links to references.html#canonical and datatypes.html#canonical, and current source/references.html links back to resource.html#canonical.
